provenance.role: DATA_PACKAGING_CUSTODIAN (excluded from ISEM evaluator author, D3 author, ISEM reviewer, sealed-evaluation executor roles)

purpose: Machine-readable specification of exactly what the FROZEN ISEM load_ground_truth accepts, derived by code reading only. No private holdout content was touched to produce this file.

derived_from.extraction_method: static code reading of load_ground_truth + helpers (_first_key, _bind_class) + frozen constants + synthetic tests in tests/test_eval_interest_semantic.py
derived_from.note: Field and value constraints below mirror the frozen loader exactly; where the loader is lenient this spec records the lenience, where it fails closed this spec records the refusal.

resolution_order.rule: first root key in ROOT_KEY_PRECEDENCE whose value is a JSON array
root key 'negatives' whose value is a JSON object; all its values that are arrays are concatenated (object value iteration order) into one row list; an empty merge yields no container
the document itself is a bare JSON array

root_containers.fail_closed: if no container resolves, loader raises SchemaBindError('no known root container'); error text discloses only the first 12 sorted root key NAMES
root_containers.envelope_keys_outside_containers: ignored entirely by the loader; they must not collide with the container key names above if the package wants deterministic resolution

record_requirements.row_type: each row that is not a JSON object is silently skipped by the frozen loader (rows = [item for item in rows if isinstance(item, dict)] equivalent)

field_synonym_groups.description: loader is synonym-tolerant over KEY NAMES only; within each group the first key present with a non-null value in the listed precedence order wins; value-level interpretation is fixed

semantic_class.value_rule: string value is normalized (strip, casefold, '-'->'_', ' '->'_', '_negative'->'negative', spaces removed) and must match CLASS_TAXONOMY exactly; unbindable or unknown class raises SchemaBindError

canonical_name.value_rule: must be a non-null non-empty-after-strip JSON string, else SchemaBindError('unbindable class/name')

statement_text.value_rule: kept only if a JSON string; any other JSON type binds as null (no error)

value_rule.anything_else: out-of-set STRINGS raise SchemaBindError('unusable scorability field'); non-bool non-string values (numbers, arrays, objects, null) are silently IGNORED and scorability_field binds null (no error)

label_id.value_rule: coerced to string; if the winning value is absent or FALSY (null, empty string, 0, false), a positional id '<class lowercase>_<row index>' is GENERATED (row order becomes semantically load-bearing); duplicate bound ids across all rows raise SchemaBindError

literal_key_fields.description: fields the loader reads under exactly one literal key name; no synonyms exist, so an artifact using a different key name for these concepts is silently ignored by the loader

aliases.value_rule: null/absent -> []; must be a JSON array else SchemaBindError; elements coerced to strings

probe_receipts.value_rule: null/absent -> []; non-list values are wrapped into a one-element string list; list elements coerced to strings (never errors)

record_requirements.unknown_keys: all other keys are ignored by the loader; a mechanically faithful package must PRESERVE them unchanged

class_taxonomy.note: the three lists above are the frozen SEMANTIC_CLASSES; a row binding outside them raises SchemaBindError

canonical_bound_form.description: per-row dict the frozen loader produces; this is the semantic surface the evaluator consumes

seal_verification.verify_sealed: compares the loaded file digest against the frozen SEALED_GT_SHA256 constant and refuses on mismatch
seal_verification.packaging_note: a format-only repackaged artifact necessarily has a DIFFERENT digest; rebinding SEALED_GT_SHA256 (or the binding mechanism) to the packaged digest is the evaluator-binding author's step, explicitly out of scope for packaging

packaging_canonicalization_rules.purpose: deterministic format-only transform accepted by this spec without value mutation
rules: relocate the record array into root key 'labels' (first precedence key)

per record, for each field synonym group: if the winning synonym key differs from the canonical key name, rename that one key to the canonical name; losing synonym keys and all unknown keys are preserved untouched
record order is preserved exactly (positional generated ids make order load-bearing when explicit ids are absent)
no value of any field is read, altered, added, or dropped
serialization: UTF-8, ensure_ascii=false, sort_keys=true (record arrays unaffected), fixed indent, trailing newline
